en.title: Echoes of the Iron Road, The Underground Library
en.premise: At a turning point in history, the steam engine—a symbol of civilization—tears through the mountains. To protect the 'Underground Library,' a sanctuary for forbidden knowledge that the new government seeks to suppress, the ronin Inui Saburo throws himself into a lonely battle. The clash of swords from his pursuers and the approaching roar of the locomotive shake the silence of the archives. This is a tale of the collision between the fading soul of the samurai and the relentless march of modernization.

zh.title: 铁路的残响，地下的书丛
zh.premise: 时代转折点，象征文明的蒸汽机正劈开群山。浪人乾三郎为了守护那座被新政府试图掩盖禁忌知识的“地下图书馆”，投身于一场孤独的战斗。追捕者的剑戟声与近在咫尺的铁路轰鸣声，震动着寂静的书库。这是一个讲述消逝的武士之魂与加速的现代化之间激烈碰撞的故事。
